analysis_method: Independent stdlib CSV parse and Householder QR regression; no provider, generator or evaluator imports; no patient/reference row reads or fits.
H_quantile_method: Inverse CDF on exact binary64 1/(8*375) masses, accurately summed with math.fsum, without interpolation or ceil(n*q) substitution.
L_units_and_moments: TC/HDL mmol/L multiplied by 38.67; SD ddof=1; manual linear quantiles.
checks: table and evaluation output hash bindings
all 513 generated endpoint values and missingness
cached reference copies and lipid mapping
execution_authority: Wait for explicit root release after all six sessions close. Then invoke --postclosure-authorized to a new output directory.
failure_policy: Never overwrite prior audit attempt. Record failures, fixes and reruns explicitly. No changes to frozen candidate/controller/evaluation files.
syntax_check: ast.parse passed without importing or executing the audit script
